segments.en: [This letter opens mid-sentence in the source text.]
…And the honor of the true Tzadik — who is worthy that he have…

…And for all the honor and the greatness — that all of Israel come to honor him and to draw close to him. In order that he be able to guide Israel in the holy path — and to illuminate the daas in the world. And this is the essential wholeness and repair of the honor.

…Upon which depends the essential redemption — to arouse them and to draw them to Hashem Yisburach — after Hashem Yisburach. The root of all the creation is honor. For everything that the Holy Blessed One created in His world — He created only for His honor. And therefore when new honor comes to a person, etc. (one must be careful) — to elevate it to Hashem of Hosts — who is the King of honor. And for the sake of the true Tzadik — that all the honor and the greatness be his. That all of Israel come to honor him and to draw close to him. In order that he be able to guide Israel in the holy path — and to illuminate the daas in the world — that all will know Hashem.
He will certainly complete what He has begun — to bring him close to Hashem Yisburach. To remove the heart of stone from our flesh and to give us a heart of flesh.
May Hashem complete it for his good in all ways.
